killedBy: hud.css is syntactically whole still carries the rules the features depend on
why:
Renames the verdict line's rule so the class the TypeScript writes has none. A

with no rule takes the browser's default 16px block margin, and this one repeats once per connected pad, so the channel lists are pushed down by a line per pad. Caught by hud.css.test.ts's hand-maintained presence list rather than by a sweep -- there is no sweep, which this entry found out the hard way: it SURVIVED until `.hud-selftest-pad-support` was added to that list, so the entry is also the proof the list was extended rather than assumed to cover a new class.
